headline: Man Pleads Guilty to Fraud in Sale of Art to Springsteen’s Manager
context: Thomas Doyle was accused of unlawfully pocketing most of the proceeds from the sale of a painting by Gustave Courbet to Bruce Springsteen’s manager.
